mentions.name: IsThisAI.lol
mentions.description: A web game that trains people to spot AI-generated content by having them judge whether short videos and images are AI or real. Content is hand-picked from TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit and other AI-generating platforms, and the app is SFW and localized to popular languages.
mentions.problem: Older family members can't distinguish AI videos from real ones at all as AI content floods social media.
mentions.audience: Older family members and everyday social media users who struggle to tell AI-generated videos apart from real ones.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've decided to code a weekend side project to train their Spidey sense for AI content.
